T10-01.details: Verified allowlist DTO projection drops answer, correctOption, evidenceQuote, explanation, absenceAssessment, and canaries; untrusted student text safely escaped inside <prompt> tags; extra fields rejected at schema boundary.
T10-01.name: Hidden-key and evidence canary strictly absent from serialized payload and XML envelope

T10-02.details: Swapping expected answer from 'A' to 'B' leaves BlindSolverInput SHA-256 request hash and cache key 100% invariant, while comparison outcome flips from match to mismatch.
T10-02.name: Key-swap request hash and cache key invariant with comparison outcome changed

T10-03.details: Canonical TFNG (TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN) and YNNG (YES/NO/NOT GIVEN) comparisons verified; UK/US spelling aliases normalized; fuzzy matching strictly rejected; question-type conditioned normalization enforced.
T10-03.name: TFNG and YNNG annotated pairs with whole-passage facts vs author stance distinction

T10-04.details: Grounded multiple valid options detected by adversary with verified verbatim passage spans; adjudication produces AMBIGUOUS_DEFECTIVE verdict with HIGH severity.
T10-04.name: MCQ and completion ambiguity detection by adversary creating HIGH blocker

T10-05.details: Adversary allegations relying on outside knowledge without valid passage text citations are classified as unsupported and filtered out; valid test item is accepted with KEY_CONFIRMED.
T10-05.name: Unsupported adversary outside-knowledge claims rejected without failing valid items

T10-06.details: Gateway timeout, malformed JSON, missing gateway, and budget exhaustion produce fail-closed non-pass outcomes under temporary RetryPolicy(max_attempts=1); real gateway + DurableStoreFake tests prove exact authority fencing propagation (context.authority.lease_owner & epoch), durable reservation/grant, tokens/wall-time reconciliation, and raw_text payload extraction.
T10-06.name: ProviderGateway fail-closed handling on timeout, malformed JSON, missing gateway, and budget exhaustion with SDK retry=0

T10-07.details: Cache keys computed strictly from student-visible text, passage, instructions, prompt version, model, and config; mutating option text, prompt stem, or passage text automatically invalidates cache key.
T10-07.name: Student-visible cache keying and automatic invalidation on option, prompt, or passage mutation

T10-08.details: Traces actual provider and model versions; dynamically refreshed from ProviderResponse; when same model is used across solver and adversary roles, correlated_review is set to true and statistical independence limitation note is attached.
T10-08.name: Model diversity profile tracing and correlated-review limitation tracking

conclusion: Phase 10 implementation, deterministic verification (10/10 tests green including schema regressions), and integration accounting achieve full PASS. All upstream predecessor quality gates (G07 clean holdout, G08 paired passage benchmark, and G09 candidate loop + R05 PostgreSQL durability) are verified and PASS. Gate G10 live acceptance achieved full PASS under campaign camp_g10_clean_holdout_20261007_v4 (184/184 child runs completed with zero errors and zero incomplete cases, overall blocking recall 97.30% >= 95.0%, per-type recall >= 90.0% across all 6 question types, ambiguity recall 90.0% >= 90.0%, false rejection rate 8.11% <= 10.0%, critical canaries 100.0% across all 3 repetitions and worst-run). Phase 11 readiness is READY_FOR_PHASE_11.
